item.title: Marvel Wanted Patrick Stewart For Both ‘Avengers’ Sequels, But He Only Agreed To ‘Doomsday’
item.description: While “ Avengers: Doomsday ” will mark Patrick Stewart ’s final screen performance, Marve l had originally hoped to bring the actor back for both of its upcoming Avengers films. According to a new report from Entertainment Weekly, Stewart was offered roles in both ‘Doomsday’ and “ Avengers: Secret Wars ,” but agreed to appear in only the former. Stewart, who died in October at 86, had played Professor Charles Xavier for more than two decades, originating the role in the 2000s’ “ X-Men ” before seemingly bidding farewell to the character in James Mangold ’s “ Logan ” in 2017.
